about: Player options read from [options] in %APPDATA%\Brotato\huepotato.cfg (Brotato's user folder). Defaults apply when the file or key is missing. They let players running other music, item or visual mods turn the matching Hue Potato part off.

rows.description: Play Hue's region music during Hue Potato runs (off: Brotato's or another mod's music keeps playing)
Play Mum's voice letters with subtitles
Add the six Hue items to Brotato's shop pool
Show Hue's colourblind symbol over each coloured enemy
Show the colour wave that sweeps out from Hue Potato when the colour changes
Hue's laser gates and skull boulders appear in later waves (off: no hazards)
Brotato's trees become Hue's coloured crates in Hue Potato runs
Hue's dust motes float over the arena
